body: This does sound related to #2382. One possible solution would be to set the primary key value as conditions in Model::save() ~ line 1832.

The problem with that is that if you set the condition, when update gets called, it doesn't call _prepareUpdateFields correctly. $quoteValues get set to false and the sql statement breaks.

Any other ideas?

That certainly complicates things. I know that in 2.6 the atomic option is being added to save() which will help as you can tune the transaction isolation level on your database to prevent these kinds of issues.
The only issue I can see with this approach is that the additional argument would cause strict errors for people with custom datasources.

I wasn't thinking of it as a fix all solution. It was more of a one off solution for us and a potential fix for others. I haven't really dived into the cakephp internals too much before so this was what I could come up with as a quick fix. 
After the last time the bug happened, it's something that's looming over our heads.
It took some effort to go back and recover the data and we don't want to have to deal with that again.

Seems like it a pretty major issue and I'm surprised others haven't seen it before.
That could work, we could use `$conditions === null && model->id` set as a shortcut to generating the default conditions.
If we caj fix it without changing the Datasource methof signatures then the changes can be applied to master.
